narrative: On the tables. Writing-tables in candlelight. The room is still night. Three words are already on the leaf, the middle one with its question mark. A right hand rests and does not rub them out.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the three words, wiped nothing, and opened a fresh sheet.

entities.name: the writing-tables
entities.context: Shown on tables in Cloves, Yaxley, and the lark
